text: A draft 2018 Business Plan is attached for Board consideration and approval. This plan is guided by the Strategic Directions for 2015-2020 approved by the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board, including a priority on buildings which are responsible for more than half of urban Green House Gas emissions; the need to mobilize both public and private capital for low-carbon solutions; Toronto Atmospheric Fund's role in charting a course to achieving deep decarbonisation by 2050; recognition that community engagement and a focus on the 'co-benefits' will make climate action more compelling; and the strength of a regional approach for advancing Toronto Atmospheric Fund's mandate in Toronto and the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area. Research and outreach undertaken in 2017 is guiding the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area-wide program, and Toronto Atmospheric Fund's track record of partnerships,…

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved Toronto Atmospheric Fund's 2018 Draft Business Plan. 2. Requested the Chief Executive Officer to consider adding a dashboard to her meeting reports which will track progress of the business plan through the year.
